$description: Wyvrn brand design tokens. Source of truth for every generated artifact in ../generated/wyvrn/. Extracted from the wyvrn.com design system (WyvrnOfficial/wyvrn, src/index.css). Canvas is pure black; surfaces sit LIGHTER than the canvas. Glow is sanctioned only through the accent-glow token.

surface.$description: Cards. Lighter than canvas by design.

accent.$description: Wyvrn green. Primary actions, links, focus rings.

accent-glow.$description: The only sanctioned glow. box-shadow color; never glow with any other value.

body.$description: Body copy. Wyvrn uses F5 throughout.

unit.$description: Base grid step. Every spacing value is a multiple of this.

lg.$description: Cards and panels. Base radius of the system.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls. Zero hover/press feedback while disabled.
